cover: Migrant boat sinks; at least 13 dead
Two men acquitted after 6 years in jail
hope_caption:
A Baramulla court acquitted two men jailed six years under the UAPA, calling police evidence unreliable; the Supreme Court told UP to trace prisoners kept in jail despite bail.
Source: Indian Express · LiveLaw

stories.label: World · Life & safety
stories.head: A migrant boat sinks off Crete
bullets: The coastguard rescued 18 people, all Sudanese.
The boat had likely been at sea for days in strong winds, authorities said.
Over 22,000 of 86,400 sea arrivals this year landed in Crete.
stories.caption:
A container ship spotted the boat about 15 nautical miles off Crete; a toddler was among four survivors taken to hospital.
Source: BBC

stories.label: World · Workers' safety
stories.head: A steel plant explosion
bullets: 12 more workers were injured at the Habaş plant, officials said.
The governor says a crane collapsed during furnace maintenance.
Some people were believed to be under the rubble.
stories.caption:
An independent labour safety group says workplace accidents remain a chronic problem in Turkey.
Source: BBC

stories.label: World · Press freedom
stories.head: Novaya Gazeta shuts down
bullets: The team held a final editorial meeting on Monday after eviction.
It investigated corruption and rights abuses for 30 years.
The Kremlin called it "a standard rotational process".
stories.caption:
Human Rights Watch says the paper was told to vacate on 29 October and its donations system was disabled.
Source: BBC · Human Rights Watch

stories.label: India · Due process
stories.head: Acquitted after six years
bullets: Held under the UAPA since a 2020 vehicle check.
Police said grenades and ammunition were found.
The court found no independent witness and inconsistent police testimony.
stories.caption:
The judge said it "would be unsafe" to base a conviction on the prosecution's evidence.
Source: Indian Express
